task:
Extend the API in src/app.js step by step. Global rule for every step: every error response body must have exactly the shape {"error": <message string>, "code": <HTTP status number>} — this includes the existing 404 for unknown routes.

1. Change `handle(method, url)` to `handle(method, url, body)` (body is an already-parsed object or undefined); keep the server working by parsing JSON request bodies in createApp.
2. GET /users/:id returns the user (200) or a 404 error.
3. POST /users with {name} creates a user with the next id and returns it with status 201; a missing or empty name is a 400 error.
4. GET /users?name=<text> filters users by case-insensitive substring of the name.
5. DELETE /users/:id removes the user (204, no body) or returns a 404 error.
6. GET /stats returns {users: <current user count>, requests: <number of handle() calls so far, including this one>}.

Add tests for every step in test/app.test.js and keep the existing tests passing. Run the tests after each step.
